description: Find the providers that fit one specific hire: the country, employee or contractor, team size and whether the person needs a work visa. Returns the best matches with the cited reasons each one fits (it employs in that country through its own entity or lists it, its published fee, visa support, deposit terms) and a BestEOR.co link where the reader can see every match and request quotes from the providers they pick.

country.description: Country name, two-letter ISO code or slug. Required for an employee.

hire_type.description: employee (through an employer of record, the default) or contractor.

needs_visa.description: The person needs the employer to sponsor a work visa or permit.

name: match_eor_providers
title: Match EOR providers to a hire
